FFT word growth: how many bits each stage adds

Pick a size, an input width and an input, with or without halving every stage. Watch the bits each stage needs grow, and what scaling holds back and what it costs.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/signals.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • AMD (Xilinx) PG109, Fast Fourier Transform LogiCORE IP Product Guide: unscaled output width = input width + log2(points) + 1
  • J. W. Cooley, J. W. Tukey, An algorithm for the machine calculation of complex Fourier series, Math. Comp. 19, 1965
